author: T05 sole oracle author; independent reviewer read-only
method: Explicit hand-selected finite sets/bindings/witnesses; this script only serializes those decisions and approved input subtrees. No engine, RDF library, arbitrary matcher, closure solver, comparator, wrapper or actual-output import.

termsConvention.triples: dictionary IDs resolve to complete three N3 terms; subject/predicate IRI presentation has angle wrappers; no RDF/value normalization
termsConvention.setEquality: exact resolved term sets for asserted/ontology/RDFS/custom, plus exact all match/head occurrences; counts insufficient
termsConvention.raw: source pointers/hash refer to supplied fixture encodings, never original preimport Turtle token or producer authentication. raw unavailable and byteSpan null where not supplied. Generated action/head terms are authored expected only.
termsConvention.sourceLabel: PRD-V0.6-E is an input label, not a new implementation executionSemanticsVersion

excludedRdfs: No generic axiomatic triples/reflexive class/subProperty/OWL inference; no matching label/comment; no custom feedback or final RDFS pass.

map-ontology-same-values.scope: ontology values equal, actual case baseline remains G-map-empty

completenessArguments.base-partition: No subclass/domain/range axioms. Equipment001-A01 is High/Open; Equipment002-A02 is High/Closed; Equipment003-A03 is Low/Open. R-risk has exactly one binding. Declarations alone add no finite RDFS facts.
completenessArguments.behavior-literal-range: Only added inference axiom is P range xsd:boolean. Its objects are literals false/true, so finite URI-only range has no conclusion. Other extra facts have no R-risk alarm patterns; base A01 is the only positive binding.
completenessArguments.no-facts: Ontology contains only declarations; asserted empty, so no subclass/domain/range candidate and no custom binding.
completenessArguments.no-alarm: No alarm link and High/Open facts exist; no rule match. Ontology declarations introduce no axioms.
completenessArguments.only-closed-or-low: A01 absent/Closed, A02 Closed, A03 Low: every available alarm fails at least one conjunct. No finite RDFS inference axiom.
completenessArguments.only-A01-remains-positive: A03 removed, Equipment003 preserved; A01 High/Open only, A02 Closed; no negated absence or new class assertion.
completenessArguments.behavior-literal-range-no-A01: P objects remain literals; range yields nothing. A01 removed; A02 Closed and A03 Low, so zero R-risk bindings.
completenessArguments.name-not-in-rule: Only a name fact changes; name is not in R-risk and no domain/range/subclass axiom was added. Base partition remains complete.
completenessArguments.two-same-output-matches: A01 and A04 both belong to001 and each independently High/Open. Exactly two bindings/heads, one deduplicated risk001 term. A02/A03 fail. No finite RDFS additions.
completenessArguments.only-A04-remains-positive: A01 removed, A04 High/Open on001 remains; A02/A03 fail. Single A04 firing and no stale A01 premise.
completenessArguments.subclass-present-no-instance: CriticalPump subClassOf Equipment is the only subclass edge; no CriticalPump instance yet and no outgoing Equipment subclass edge. No transitive addition or type propagation yet.
completenessArguments.R04-only-rdfs-pair: CriticalPump→Equipment is the only subclass edge. P001 CriticalPump is the only instance of its subject class; type P001 Equipment is the only RDFS addition. Equipment has no successor edge, no domain/range. Base001/A01 and P001/A-P001 are exactly the two R-risk bindings; no custom feedback.
completenessArguments.no-feedback-R-next-zero-matches: R-next is saved+enabled. Its required HighRiskEquipment type exists only in custom output, not the frozen asserted+RDFS input. Exactly zero R-next bindings; keep chain warning. R-risk still has only A01. No final RDFS pass.
completenessArguments.explicit-event-alarm-partition: Explicit event input adds only its listed alarm. B01/B07: A01 and A04 positive; B02: A01 positive and A05 Low; B03: A01 deleted, A06 sole positive. A02 Closed/A03 Low. No finite RDFS axioms.
completenessArguments.workorder-does-not-affect-R-risk: Only explicit WorkOrder type/status/eventOrder facts added or updated after event injection. These predicates do not add RDFS axioms or alter alarm patterns. The explicitly enumerated earlier alarm match set remains complete.
completenessArguments.no-rules-or-rdfs-axioms: Repair fixture supplies declarations and name constraint, no rule definitions or finite RDFS inference axioms. No custom or RDFS output is implied by its ruleVersion label.
completenessArguments.transfer-only-T-A1: 201 Equipment linked only to T-A1 High/Open: exactly one rule binding, output risk201. No subclass/domain/range axiom.
completenessArguments.declarations-not-domain-or-range: The supplied course delta contains Person/assignedTo declarations and two asserted instance/relation facts, no rules/domain/range axioms. Its finite graph projection has no outputs. Prior project graph is unspecified; do not infer it from glossary or G-base.
completenessArguments.E5-all-arrived-alarms-High-Open: Exactly the enumerated arrived AE001..AE00n alarm links each carry High and Open on001; every one yields a distinct binding to the same risk001. Completing orders never changes alarm status. Future event facts are absent, no other Equipment facts/alarms/finite RDFS axioms.
completenessArguments.one-score-single-pattern-match: Only001 has exactly one score triple and Equipment type. 002/003 have no score; exactly one positive triple-pattern binding before comparison. Manual truth table determines accepted Boolean; no base R-risk is inherited. No finite RDFS axiom.
completenessArguments.base-A01-one-match-two-heads: Only A01 High/Open on001; one binding with head indices0/1 retained. Exactly risk001 and derivedLabel needs-review, both dedup-set and occurrence lists explicit; no base rule inheritance or feedback.
completenessArguments.A02-A04-closed-A03-A05-low-no-single-Hig: 001 A04 is High/Closed and A05 Low/Open; 002 A02 High/Closed; 003 A03 Low/Open. Shared alarm variable cannot combine A04 High with A05 Open: zero matches, zero heads. No finite RDFS axiom.
completenessArguments.disabled-rule-not-evaluated: The only rule is disabled revision2. Its two heads and legal definitions remain in input; no enabled graph matches or outputs. R-risk is not inherited.
completenessArguments.no-score-no-match-not-negation: No subject has score in the exact input graph, so zero complete when bindings. Constant comparison definition still valid; no false/negative fact inferred from missing property.
